calls.name: WAN HAI LINES
calls.why: Float-adjusted cap $1.84B is below the §2.3.6.1 constituent gate $2.25B (50% of the $6.75B cutoff, with the 2/3 relief incumbents get). Its FIF is 0.251 — MSCI's OWN number, recovered from the published weights, so this is not float-estimate risk. Full cap $7.34B would survive on size alone; the float is what fails. Note the mechanism: foreign room is 10.8%, inside the 7.5-15% band, so §2.3.6.2 applies an adjustment factor of 0.5 — and indeed MSCI's FIF 0.251 is almost exactly half of 0.502. Low foreign room does NOT delete on its own; it halves the float, and the halved float is what breaches the gate.

calls.name: CALIWAY BIOPHARMA
caveats: displacement is CONDITIONAL on the additions landing — it is the weakest link in the chain
calls.why: Passes every rule on its own (full cap $4.95B = 0.73x cutoff, above the 2/3 floor), but it is among the smallest surviving incumbents. With 8 additions qualifying and the Segment Number of Companies held at 77 (§2.3.3), the smallest members are displaced to make room. This is the channel that produced 5 of the 6 deletions in the previous call.
